# wstrust — WS-Trust

[All groups](README.md)

## wstrust issue

Request a token from a WS-Trust STS (RST Issue over SOAP with a WS-Security UsernameToken, as AD FS usernamemixed expects) and check the response: SOAP faults, RSTR lifetime and AppliesTo, and the SAML 1.1 or 2.0 token's signature, audience and validity.

MCP tool: `wstrust_issue`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--endpoint` | string | STS endpoint, e.g. https://adfs.example.com/adfs/services/trust/13/usernamemixed. **Required.** |
| `--applies-to` | string | Relying party identifier the token is for. **Required.** |
| `--token-type` | string | Requested token type. Default `saml2`. One of `saml2`, `saml11`. |
| `--username` | string | UsernameToken user (e.g. user@domain for AD FS usernamemixed). |
| `--password` | string | UsernameToken password (prefer env IDPDBG_PASSWORD or a profile); only sent over https. Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--version` | string | WS-Trust version. Default `1.3`. One of `1.3`, `2005`. |
| `--soap` | string | SOAP version. Default `1.2`. One of `1.2`, `1.1`. |
| `--metadata` | string | Federation metadata (URL, path or inline XML) for the STS signing certificates. May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--sts-cert` | string | STS signing certificate (PEM). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--leeway` | int | Clock skew allowance in seconds. Default `120`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).

## wstrust validate

Ask a WS-Trust STS whether a token is valid (RST Validate) and report the status code and reason.

MCP tool: `wstrust_validate`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--endpoint` | string | STS endpoint. **Required.** |
| `--token` | string | Token XML to validate (CLI: @file). **Required.** CLI: `@path` reads a file, `-` reads stdin. |
| `--username` | string | UsernameToken user (e.g. user@domain for AD FS usernamemixed). |
| `--password` | string | UsernameToken password (prefer env IDPDBG_PASSWORD or a profile); only sent over https. Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--version` | string | WS-Trust version. Default `1.3`. One of `1.3`, `2005`. |
| `--soap` | string | SOAP version. Default `1.2`. One of `1.2`, `1.1`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
